Front Desk Officer Job at JVEE Wellness and Spa




        
    

        
        JVEE Wellness and Spa is a luxury day spa located in a beautiful, serene setting. The spa offers a range of services designed to promote relaxation, rejuvenation, and overall well-being. Services include massage therapy, body treatments, facials, and manicures and pedicures. The spa also has a cafe that serves healthy snacks and beverages, as well as a gift shop that sells luxury bath and body products. JVEE Wellness and Spa is committed to providing a serene and welcoming environment, and all services are performed by highly trained and certified professionals.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Front Desk Officer

Job Location: Mabushi, Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time
     

            
    



Job Summary


	We are seeking a well-presented, elegant, and articulate Front Desk Officer to be the face of our spa.
	The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication skills, a warm personality, and a strong ability to manage client interactions with professionalism and poise.
	She will be responsible for creating a welcoming environment, managing bookings, and ensuring an exceptional customer experience at all times.


Key Responsibilities


	Greet and welcome clients in a warm, friendly, and professional manner
	Manage appointments, bookings, and client scheduling efficiently
	Handle incoming calls, messages, and inquiries promptly
	Maintain a clean, organized, and inviting front desk area
	Process payments and issue receipts accurately
	Provide clients with information about services, promotions, and products
	Handle client complaints or concerns calmly and professionally
	Coordinate with therapists and other staff to ensure smooth operations
	Maintain client records and ensure confidentiality


Requirements


	Preferably a lady
	Minimum of OND / HND / B.Sc.Degree in any relevant field
	Proven experience in a front desk, receptionist, or customer service role (spa or hospitality experience is an advantage)
	Must be well-spoken, polite, and have excellent communication skills
	Strong customer relationship and interpersonal skills
	Must be neat, elegant, and well-groomed at all times
	Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment
	Basic computer skills (booking systems, WhatsApp, etc.)


Additional Requirement:


	Applicants must attach a recent professional photograph with their application.


What We Offer


	Basic Salary: N150,000 per month
	Commission: N1,000 for each product sold
	Accommodation provided.


Method of Applictaion 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV along with a recent photograph to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

	Strong numerical skills and ability to handle cash with accuracy and integrity

	Smart appearance and professional conduct at all times.
